-- Rather than calling DestroyBody (which would cause double-free when the C++
-- slot unloader tries to destroy the same bodies tracked in its dynamic list),
-- we simply zero out friction/restitution/gravity so the peg becomes inert.
local function DeactivatePeg(handle)
    if not handle or handle <= 0 then return end
    MidwayPhysics.SetFriction     (handle, 0.0)
    MidwayPhysics.SetRestitution  (handle, 0.0)
    MidwayPhysics.SetGravityFactor(handle, 0.0)
    peg_type_of[handle] = nil
end

-- ── Check fragile peg proximity ───────────────────────────────────────────────
-- If a ball is within fragile_trigger_radius of a fragile peg,
-- "shatter" it and give the ball a small velocity boost.
local function CheckFragilePegs()
    if #pegs_by_type.fragile == 0 then return end

    for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
        local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
        if not bx then break end

        local i = #pegs_by_type.fragile
        while i >= 1 do
            local peg = pegs_by_type.fragile[i]

            -- Skip already-deactivated pegs (clean up the list)
            if not peg_type_of[peg.handle] then
                table.remove(pegs_by_type.fragile, i)
            else
                local dx, dy, dz = bx - peg.x, by - peg.y, bz - peg.z
                local dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)

                if dist < PEG.fragile_trigger_radius then
                    DeactivatePeg(peg.handle)
                    table.remove(pegs_by_type.fragile, i)

                    -- Velocity kick to the ball
                    local vx, vy, vz = MidwayPhysics.GetVelocity(ballHandle)
                    if vx then
                        vx = vx + (math.random() - 0.5) * PEG.fragile_kick
                        vy = vy + PEG.fragile_kick * 0.5
                        vz = vz + (math.random() - 0.5) * PEG.fragile_kick
                        MidwayPhysics.SetLinearVelocity(ballHandle, vx, vy, vz)
                    end
                    break  -- one peg shattered per ball per frame
                end
            end
            i = i - 1
        end
    end
end

-- ── Check explosive peg proximity ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- If a ball is within explosive_trigger_radius of an explosive peg,
-- apply outward radial impulse and deactivate the peg.
local function CheckExplosivePegs()
    if #pegs_by_type.explosive == 0 then return end

    for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
        local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
        if not bx then break end

        local i = #pegs_by_type.explosive
        while i >= 1 do
            local peg = pegs_by_type.explosive[i]

            if not peg_type_of[peg.handle] then
                table.remove(pegs_by_type.explosive, i)
            else
                local dx, dy, dz = bx - peg.x, by - peg.y, bz - peg.z
                local dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)

                if dist < PEG.explosive_trigger_radius then
                    DeactivatePeg(peg.handle)
                    table.remove(pegs_by_type.explosive, i)

                    -- Outward radial impulse
                    if dist > 0.01 then
                        local impulseScale = PEG.explosive_force / dist
                        MidwayPhysics.ApplyImpulse(ballHandle,
                            dx * impulseScale,
                            dy * impulseScale,
                            dz * impulseScale)
                    else
                        MidwayPhysics.ApplyImpulse(ballHandle, 0, PEG.explosive_force, 0)
                    end
                    break  -- one peg detonated per ball per frame
                end
            end
            i = i - 1
        end
    end

-- ── Peg state tables ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Stored by handle with type info for runtime behaviour
local pegs_by_type = {
    normal    = {},
    bouncy    = {},
    sticky    = {},
    fragile   = {},
    explosive = {},

-- Reverse map: handle -> type string
local peg_type_of = {}

-- Active ball tracking
local ball_pool_name = "plinko_balls_" .. tostring(SLOT_ID)

local liveCount = 0
local ballTimer = 0.0
local diagTimer = 0.0
local diagInterval = 1.0
local slotScores = {}         -- slot index -> running ticket count

-- Slot sensor handles
local slotSensors = {}        -- slot index -> sensor handle
local slotMultipliers = {}    -- slot index -> multiplier value

local totalBallsDropped = 0
local ballsOnBoard = 0
local totalTicketScore = 0

-- ── Peg type randomisation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Normal: 40%, Bouncy: 20%, Sticky: 20%, Fragile: 10%, Explosive: 10%
local PEG_TYPE_WEIGHTS = {
    normal    = 40,
    bouncy    = 20,
    sticky    = 20,
    fragile   = 10,
    explosive = 10,
}

local totalWeight = 0
local pegTypes = {}
for t, w in pairs(PEG_TYPE_WEIGHTS) do
    totalWeight = totalWeight + w
    for i = 1, w do table.insert(pegTypes, t) end
end

-- Seed RNG with slot ID for deterministic per-slot layout
math.randomseed(SLOT_ID * 7919 + 13)

local function PickPegType()
    return pegTypes[math.random(1, totalWeight)]
end

-- ── Generate peg field ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Triangular (diamond) pattern:
--   Row 0 (Y=top):  7 pegs  (even rows)
--   Row 1:          6 pegs  (odd rows, offset half spacing)
--   Row 2:          7 pegs
--   ...
-- Bottom row feeds into 7 scoring slots (one below each gap between bottom pegs).
--
-- Even rows: pegs at x = offset + i * spacing,  i=0..pegsPerRow-1
-- Odd rows:  pegs at x = offset + spacing/2 + i * spacing

-- Board is now in the ZY plane (wide axis = Z, tall axis = Y).
-- board_x is the fixed X position of all pegs/sensors (face-on to the player).
local function BuildPegField()
    local pegsPerEven = 7
    local pegsPerOdd  = 6
    local yStart = BOARD.peg_top_y
    local yEnd   = BOARD.peg_bot_y
    local numRows = 8
    local rowSpacing = (yStart - yEnd) / (numRows - 1)
    local zStart = -(pegsPerEven - 1) * PEG.h_spacing * 0.5  -- centred on Z=0

    local totalPegs = 0

    for row = 0, numRows - 1 do
        local y = yStart - row * rowSpacing
        local isEven = (row % 2 == 0)
        local count = isEven and pegsPerEven or pegsPerOdd
        local zOff = zStart
        if not isEven then
            zOff = zStart + PEG.h_spacing * 0.5
        end

        for i = 0, count - 1 do
            local pz = zOff + i * PEG.h_spacing
            local ptype = PickPegType()

            local restitution = PEG.restitution_normal
            local friction    = PEG.friction_normal
            if ptype == "bouncy" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_bouncy
                friction    = PEG.friction_bouncy
            elseif ptype == "sticky" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_sticky
                friction    = PEG.friction_sticky
            elseif ptype == "fragile" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_fragile
                friction    = PEG.friction_fragile
            elseif ptype == "explosive" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_explosive
                friction    = PEG.friction_explosive
            end

            -- Pegs placed at (board_x, y, pz) — board face is in the ZY plane
            local handle = MidwayPhysics.SpawnStaticSphere(BOARD.board_x, y, pz, PEG.radius)
            if handle > 0 then
                MidwayPhysics.SetRestitution(handle, restitution)
                MidwayPhysics.SetFriction(handle, friction)

                local entry = { handle = handle, x = BOARD.board_x, y = y, z = pz, ptype = ptype }
                table.insert(pegs_by_type[ptype], entry)
                peg_type_of[handle] = ptype
                totalPegs = totalPegs + 1
            end
        end
    end

    print(string.format("[plinko] slot#%d  Peg field: %d pegs (n=%d b=%d s=%d f=%d e=%d)",
        SLOT_ID, totalPegs,
        #pegs_by_type.normal, #pegs_by_type.bouncy,
        #pegs_by_type.sticky, #pegs_by_type.fragile,
        #pegs_by_type.explosive))
end

-- ── Build scoring slots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 7 slots, centered, each SLOT.width wide.  Slots are sensor boxes.
-- When a ball enters a sensor box, score the ball at that slot's multiplier.
-- 7 slots span Z, centred on Z=0. Sensors sit at (board_x, SLOT.y, sz).
local function BuildScoringSlots()
    local numSlots = 7
    local totalWidth = numSlots * SLOT.width
    local zStart = -totalWidth * 0.5 + SLOT.width * 0.5
    local multipliers = { 2, 5, 10, 50, 10, 5, 2 }

    for i = 1, numSlots do
        local sz = zStart + (i - 1) * SLOT.width

        local sensor = MidwayPhysics.SpawnSensorBox(BOARD.board_x, SLOT.y, sz,
            SLOT.depth * 2, SLOT.height, SLOT.width * 0.9)
        slotSensors[i] = sensor
        slotMultipliers[i] = multipliers[i]
        slotScores[i] = 0
    end
end

-- ── Create ball pool ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Sphere-based object pool for plinko balls.
local function CreateBallPool()
    local poolParams = {
        shape    = "sphere",
        radius   = BALL.radius,
        mass     = BALL.base_mass,
        friction = BALL.friction,
        restitution = BALL.restitution,
        linearDamping  = BALL.linear_damping,
        angularDamping = BALL.angular_damping,
    }
    local ok = MidwayPhysics.CreatePool(ball_pool_name, BALL.pool_hot, BALL.pool_cold, poolParams)
    if ok then
        print(string.format("[plinko] slot#%d  Ball pool created: %s", SLOT_ID, ball_pool_name))
    else
        print(string.format("[plinko] slot#%d  Ball pool already exists or failed", SLOT_ID))
    end
end

-- ── Spawn a ball at random X near the top ─────────────────────────────────────
-- Returns the handle, or 0 if pool exhausted.
-- Sleight of Hand modifier narrows the X drop spread.
local function SpawnBall()
    if MidwayPhysics.PoolFree(ball_pool_name) <= 0 then
        return 0
    end

    local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers
    -- Sleight of Hand narrows the Z drop spread
    local spread = BOARD.drop_spread * math.max(0.2, 1.0 - math.abs(MOD.sleight_of_hand) * 0.5)
    local bx = BOARD.board_x
    local by = BOARD.drop_y
    local bz = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread  -- vary along Z, not X

    local handle = MidwayPhysics.PoolAcquire(ball_pool_name, bx, by, bz)
    if handle > 0 then
        local mass = math.max(0.001, MOD.mass * BALL.base_mass)
        MidwayPhysics.SetMass(handle, mass)
        local ballFriction = math.max(0.0, MOD.friction * BALL.friction)
        MidwayPhysics.SetFriction(handle, ballFriction)

        liveBalls[handle] = true
        liveCount = liveCount + 1
        ballsOnBoard = ballsOnBoard + 1
        totalBallsDropped = totalBallsDropped + 1
    end
    return handle
end

-- ── Deactivate a peg (zero its collision properties) ─────────────────────────
-- Rather than calling DestroyBody (which would cause double-free when the C++
-- slot unloader tries to destroy the same bodies tracked in its dynamic list),
-- we simply zero out friction/restitution/gravity so the peg becomes inert.
local function DeactivatePeg(handle)
    if not handle or handle <= 0 then return end
    MidwayPhysics.SetFriction     (handle, 0.0)
    MidwayPhysics.SetRestitution  (handle, 0.0)
    MidwayPhysics.SetGravityFactor(handle, 0.0)
    peg_type_of[handle] = nil
end

-- ── Check fragile peg proximity ───────────────────────────────────────────────
-- If a ball is within fragile_trigger_radius of a fragile peg,
-- "shatter" it and give the ball a small velocity boost.
local function CheckFragilePegs()
    if #pegs_by_type.fragile == 0 then return end

    for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
        local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
        if not bx then break end

        local i = #pegs_by_type.fragile
        while i >= 1 do
            local peg = pegs_by_type.fragile[i]

            -- Skip already-deactivated pegs (clean up the list)
            if not peg_type_of[peg.handle] then
                table.remove(pegs_by_type.fragile, i)
            else
                local dx, dy, dz = bx - peg.x, by - peg.y, bz - peg.z
                local dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)

                if dist < PEG.fragile_trigger_radius then
                    DeactivatePeg(peg.handle)
                    table.remove(pegs_by_type.fragile, i)

                    -- Velocity kick to the ball
                    local vx, vy, vz = MidwayPhysics.GetVelocity(ballHandle)
                    if vx then
                        vx = vx + (math.random() - 0.5) * PEG.fragile_kick
                        vy = vy + PEG.fragile_kick * 0.5
                        vz = vz + (math.random() - 0.5) * PEG.fragile_kick
                        MidwayPhysics.SetLinearVelocity(ballHandle, vx, vy, vz)
                    end
                    break  -- one peg shattered per ball per frame
                end
            end
            i = i - 1
        end
    end
end

-- ── Check explosive peg proximity ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- If a ball is within explosive_trigger_radius of an explosive peg,
-- apply outward radial impulse and deactivate the peg.
local function CheckExplosivePegs()
    if #pegs_by_type.explosive == 0 then return end

    for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
        local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
        if not bx then break end

        local i = #pegs_by_type.explosive
        while i >= 1 do
            local peg = pegs_by_type.explosive[i]

            if not peg_type_of[peg.handle] then
                table.remove(pegs_by_type.explosive, i)
            else
                local dx, dy, dz = bx - peg.x, by - peg.y, bz - peg.z
                local dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)

                if dist < PEG.explosive_trigger_radius then
                    DeactivatePeg(peg.handle)
                    table.remove(pegs_by_type.explosive, i)

                    -- Outward radial impulse
                    if dist > 0.01 then
                        local impulseScale = PEG.explosive_force / dist
                        MidwayPhysics.ApplyImpulse(ballHandle,
                            dx * impulseScale,
                            dy * impulseScale,
                            dz * impulseScale)
                    else
                        MidwayPhysics.ApplyImpulse(ballHandle, 0, PEG.explosive_force, 0)
                    end
                    break  -- one peg detonated per ball per frame
                end
            end
            i = i - 1
        end
    end
end

-- ── Score balls in slots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Check each slot sensor.  If triggered, find the ball in it and score it.
-- The ball is then returned to the pool.
local function CheckSlotScoring()
    for slotIdx, sensorHandle in pairs(slotSensors) do
        if MidwayPhysics.IsSensorTriggered(sensorHandle) then
            for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
                local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
                if bx and by then
                    if math.abs(by - SLOT.y) < SLOT.height then
                        local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers
                        local mult = slotMultipliers[slotIdx]
                        -- Luck modifier boosts payout
                        local luckBoost = math.max(0, 1.0 + MOD.luck * 0.5)
                        local score = math.floor(mult * luckBoost + 0.5)

                        slotScores[slotIdx] = slotScores[slotIdx] + score
                        totalTicketScore = totalTicketScore + score
                        ballsOnBoard = ballsOnBoard - 1

                        -- Award tickets through the engine economy bridge
                        local label = string.format("PLINKO  x%d", mult)
                        Engine.AwardTickets(score, label)

                        -- Return ball to pool
                        liveBalls[ballHandle] = nil
                        liveCount = liveCount - 1
                        MidwayPhysics.PoolReturn(ball_pool_name, ballHandle)
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ── Cull balls below the board ────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Any ball that falls below the gutter Y gets returned to the pool.
local function CullLostBalls()
    local culled = MidwayPhysics.PoolCullBelow(ball_pool_name, BALL.cull_y)
    for _, handle in ipairs(culled) do
        if liveBalls[handle] then
            ballsOnBoard = ballsOnBoard - 1
            liveBalls[handle] = nil
            liveCount = liveCount - 1
        end
    end
end

-- ── Ball drop timer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Heat modifier speeds up the drop rate and raises the cap.
local function TickBallSpawner(dt)
    local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers
    local heatMul = math.max(0.25, 1.0 + MOD.heat * 0.15)
    local interval = BALL.drop_interval_s / heatMul
    local maxOnBoard = math.max(1, BALL.max_concurrent + math.floor(MOD.heat * 3))

    ballTimer = ballTimer + dt
    if ballTimer >= interval and ballsOnBoard < maxOnBoard then
        ballTimer = 0
        SpawnBall()  -- SpawnBall increments ballsOnBoard internally
    end
end

-- ── Diagnostics ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function PrintDiagnostics()
    local totalScore = 0
    for i = 1, 7 do
        totalScore = totalScore + (slotScores[i] or 0)
    end

    local poolFree = MidwayPhysics.PoolFree(ball_pool_name)

    print(string.format(
        "[plinko] slot#%d  dropped=%d  onBoard=%d  poolFree=%d  fragile=%d  explosive=%d  totalScore=%d",
        SLOT_ID, totalBallsDropped, ballsOnBoard,
        poolFree,
        #pegs_by_type.fragile, #pegs_by_type.explosive,
        totalTicketScore))
end

        BOARD.cabinet_w, BOARD.cabinet_h, BOARD.cabinet_d)

    -- Floor
    MidwayPhysics.SpawnStaticBox(0.0, 0.1, 0.0,
        4.0, 0.2, BOARD.cabinet_d)

    print(string.format("[plinko] OnLoadStatic complete slot#%d", SLOT_ID))
end

-- OnLoad  -  dynamic gameplay setup
-- Called when player activates the booth.
-- Spawns peg field, scoring slots, ball pool, and step callback.
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function OnLoad()
    print(string.format("[plinko] OnLoad slot#%d", SLOT_ID))

    -- Reset all state tables for a fresh game
    pegs_by_type = {
        normal = {}; bouncy = {}; sticky = {}; fragile = {}; explosive = {}
    }
    peg_type_of = {}
    liveBalls = {}
    liveCount = 0
    ballsOnBoard = 0
    totalBallsDropped = 0
    totalTicketScore = 0
    ballTimer = 0.0
    diagTimer = 0.0
    slotSensors = {}
    slotMultipliers = {}
    slotScores = {}

    -- Build gameplay elements
    BuildPegField()       -- 8 rows, triangular pattern, 5 peg types
    BuildScoringSlots()   -- 7 sensor boxes at bottom
    CreateBallPool()      -- sphere-based object pool

    -- Register per-frame step callback
    MidwayPhysics.OnStep(function(dt)
        local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers

        -- Re-apply ball mass/friction each frame from live modifiers
        for handle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
            local mass = math.max(0.001, MOD.mass * BALL.base_mass)
            MidwayPhysics.SetMass(handle, mass)
            local ballFriction = math.max(0.0, MOD.friction * BALL.friction)
            MidwayPhysics.SetFriction(handle, ballFriction)
        end

        -- Fragile peg proximity -> shatter
        CheckFragilePegs()

        -- Explosive peg proximity -> detonate
        CheckExplosivePegs()

        -- Score balls that land in slots
        CheckSlotScoring()

        -- Cull balls that fall below gutter
        CullLostBalls()

        -- Spawn new balls on timer
        TickBallSpawner(dt)

        -- Periodic diagnostics
        diagTimer = diagTimer + dt
        if diagTimer >= diagInterval then
            diagTimer = 0.0
            PrintDiagnostics()
        end
    end)

    print(string.format("[plinko] OnLoad complete slot#%d  pegs=%d+%d+%d+%d+%d",
        SLOT_ID,
        #pegs_by_type.normal, #pegs_by_type.bouncy,
        #pegs_by_type.sticky, #pegs_by_type.fragile,
        #pegs_by_type.explosive))
end

-- OnUnload  -  cleanup on player walk-away or station recycle

        SLOT_ID, totalBallsDropped, totalTicketScore))
end

-- Stored by handle with type info for runtime behaviour
local pegs_by_type = {
    normal    = {},
    bouncy    = {},
    sticky    = {},
    fragile   = {},
    explosive = {},
}
-- Reverse map: handle -> type string
local peg_type_of = {}

-- Active ball tracking
local ball_pool_name = "plinko_balls_" .. tostring(SLOT_ID)
local liveBalls = {}          -- handle -> true
local liveCount = 0
local ballTimer = 0.0
local diagTimer = 0.0
local diagInterval = 1.0
local slotScores = {}         -- slot index -> running ticket count

-- Slot sensor handles
local slotSensors = {}        -- slot index -> sensor handle
local slotMultipliers = {}    -- slot index -> multiplier value

-- Stats
local totalBallsDropped = 0
local ballsOnBoard = 0
local totalTicketScore = 0

-- ── Peg type randomisation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Normal: 40%, Bouncy: 20%, Sticky: 20%, Fragile: 10%, Explosive: 10%
local PEG_TYPE_WEIGHTS = {
    normal    = 40,
    bouncy    = 20,
    sticky    = 20,
    fragile   = 10,
    explosive = 10,
}

local totalWeight = 0
local pegTypes = {}
for t, w in pairs(PEG_TYPE_WEIGHTS) do
    totalWeight = totalWeight + w
    for i = 1, w do table.insert(pegTypes, t) end
end

-- Seed RNG with slot ID for deterministic per-slot layout
math.randomseed(SLOT_ID * 7919 + 13)

local function PickPegType()
    return pegTypes[math.random(1, totalWeight)]
end

-- ── Generate peg field ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Triangular (diamond) pattern:
--   Row 0 (Y=top):  7 pegs  (even rows)
--   Row 1:          6 pegs  (odd rows, offset half spacing)
--   Row 2:          7 pegs
--   ...
-- Bottom row feeds into 7 scoring slots (one below each gap between bottom pegs).
--
-- Even rows: pegs at x = offset + i * spacing,  i=0..pegsPerRow-1
-- Odd rows:  pegs at x = offset + spacing/2 + i * spacing

-- Board is now in the ZY plane (wide axis = Z, tall axis = Y).
-- board_x is the fixed X position of all pegs/sensors (face-on to the player).
local function BuildPegField()
    local pegsPerEven = 7
    local pegsPerOdd  = 6
    local yStart = BOARD.peg_top_y
    local yEnd   = BOARD.peg_bot_y
    local numRows = 8
    local rowSpacing = (yStart - yEnd) / (numRows - 1)
    local zStart = -(pegsPerEven - 1) * PEG.h_spacing * 0.5  -- centred on Z=0

    local totalPegs = 0

    for row = 0, numRows - 1 do
        local y = yStart - row * rowSpacing
        local isEven = (row % 2 == 0)
        local count = isEven and pegsPerEven or pegsPerOdd
        local zOff = zStart
        if not isEven then
            zOff = zStart + PEG.h_spacing * 0.5
        end

        for i = 0, count - 1 do
            local pz = zOff + i * PEG.h_spacing
            local ptype = PickPegType()

            local restitution = PEG.restitution_normal
            local friction    = PEG.friction_normal
            if ptype == "bouncy" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_bouncy
                friction    = PEG.friction_bouncy
            elseif ptype == "sticky" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_sticky
                friction    = PEG.friction_sticky
            elseif ptype == "fragile" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_fragile
                friction    = PEG.friction_fragile
            elseif ptype == "explosive" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_explosive
                friction    = PEG.friction_explosive
            end

            -- Pegs placed at (board_x, y, pz) — board face is in the ZY plane
            local handle = MidwayPhysics.SpawnStaticSphere(BOARD.board_x, y, pz, PEG.radius)
            if handle > 0 then
                MidwayPhysics.SetRestitution(handle, restitution)
                MidwayPhysics.SetFriction(handle, friction)

                local entry = { handle = handle, x = BOARD.board_x, y = y, z = pz, ptype = ptype }
                table.insert(pegs_by_type[ptype], entry)
                peg_type_of[handle] = ptype
                totalPegs = totalPegs + 1
            end
        end
    end

    print(string.format("[plinko] slot#%d  Peg field: %d pegs (n=%d b=%d s=%d f=%d e=%d)",
        SLOT_ID, totalPegs,
        #pegs_by_type.normal, #pegs_by_type.bouncy,
        #pegs_by_type.sticky, #pegs_by_type.fragile,
        #pegs_by_type.explosive))
end

-- ── Build scoring slots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 7 slots, centered, each SLOT.width wide.  Slots are sensor boxes.
-- When a ball enters a sensor box, score the ball at that slot's multiplier.
-- 7 slots span Z, centred on Z=0. Sensors sit at (board_x, SLOT.y, sz).
local function BuildScoringSlots()
    local numSlots = 7
    local totalWidth = numSlots * SLOT.width
    local zStart = -totalWidth * 0.5 + SLOT.width * 0.5
    local multipliers = { 2, 5, 10, 50, 10, 5, 2 }

    for i = 1, numSlots do
        local sz = zStart + (i - 1) * SLOT.width

        local sensor = MidwayPhysics.SpawnSensorBox(BOARD.board_x, SLOT.y, sz,
            SLOT.depth * 2, SLOT.height, SLOT.width * 0.9)
        slotSensors[i] = sensor
        slotMultipliers[i] = multipliers[i]
        slotScores[i] = 0
    end
end

-- ── Create ball pool ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Sphere-based object pool for plinko balls.
local function CreateBallPool()
    local poolParams = {
        shape    = "sphere",
        radius   = BALL.radius,
        mass     = BALL.base_mass,
        friction = BALL.friction,
        restitution = BALL.restitution,
        linearDamping  = BALL.linear_damping,
        angularDamping = BALL.angular_damping,
    }
    local ok = MidwayPhysics.CreatePool(ball_pool_name, BALL.pool_hot, BALL.pool_cold, poolParams)
    if ok then
        print(string.format("[plinko] slot#%d  Ball pool created: %s", SLOT_ID, ball_pool_name))
    else
        print(string.format("[plinko] slot#%d  Ball pool already exists or failed", SLOT_ID))
    end
end

-- ── Spawn a ball at random X near the top ─────────────────────────────────────
-- Returns the handle, or 0 if pool exhausted.
-- Sleight of Hand modifier narrows the X drop spread.
local function SpawnBall()
    if MidwayPhysics.PoolFree(ball_pool_name) <= 0 then
        return 0
    end

    local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers
    -- Sleight of Hand narrows the Z drop spread
    local spread = BOARD.drop_spread * math.max(0.2, 1.0 - math.abs(MOD.sleight_of_hand) * 0.5)
    local bx = BOARD.board_x
    local by = BOARD.drop_y
    local bz = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread  -- vary along Z, not X

    local handle = MidwayPhysics.PoolAcquire(ball_pool_name, bx, by, bz)
    if handle > 0 then
        local mass = math.max(0.001, MOD.mass * BALL.base_mass)
        MidwayPhysics.SetMass(handle, mass)
        local ballFriction = math.max(0.0, MOD.friction * BALL.friction)
        MidwayPhysics.SetFriction(handle, ballFriction)

        liveBalls[handle] = true
        liveCount = liveCount + 1
        ballsOnBoard = ballsOnBoard + 1
        totalBallsDropped = totalBallsDropped + 1
    end
    return handle
end

-- ── Deactivate a peg (zero its collision properties) ─────────────────────────
-- Rather than calling DestroyBody (which would cause double-free when the C++
-- slot unloader tries to destroy the same bodies tracked in its dynamic list),
-- we simply zero out friction/restitution/gravity so the peg becomes inert.
local function DeactivatePeg(handle)
    if not handle or handle <= 0 then return end
    MidwayPhysics.SetFriction     (handle, 0.0)
    MidwayPhysics.SetRestitution  (handle, 0.0)
    MidwayPhysics.SetGravityFactor(handle, 0.0)
    peg_type_of[handle] = nil
end

-- ── Check fragile peg proximity ───────────────────────────────────────────────
-- If a ball is within fragile_trigger_radius of a fragile peg,
-- "shatter" it and give the ball a small velocity boost.
local function CheckFragilePegs()
    if #pegs_by_type.fragile == 0 then return end

    for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
        local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
        if not bx then break end

        local i = #pegs_by_type.fragile
        while i >= 1 do
            local peg = pegs_by_type.fragile[i]

            -- Skip already-deactivated pegs (clean up the list)
            if not peg_type_of[peg.handle] then
                table.remove(pegs_by_type.fragile, i)
            else
                local dx, dy, dz = bx - peg.x, by - peg.y, bz - peg.z
                local dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)

                if dist < PEG.fragile_trigger_radius then
                    DeactivatePeg(peg.handle)
                    table.remove(pegs_by_type.fragile, i)

                    -- Velocity kick to the ball
                    local vx, vy, vz = MidwayPhysics.GetVelocity(ballHandle)
                    if vx then
                        vx = vx + (math.random() - 0.5) * PEG.fragile_kick
                        vy = vy + PEG.fragile_kick * 0.5
                        vz = vz + (math.random() - 0.5) * PEG.fragile_kick
                        MidwayPhysics.SetLinearVelocity(ballHandle, vx, vy, vz)
                    end
                    break  -- one peg shattered per ball per frame
                end
            end
            i = i - 1
        end
    end
end

-- ── Check explosive peg proximity ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- If a ball is within explosive_trigger_radius of an explosive peg,
-- apply outward radial impulse and deactivate the peg.
local function CheckExplosivePegs()
    if #pegs_by_type.explosive == 0 then return end

    for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
        local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
        if not bx then break end

        local i = #pegs_by_type.explosive
        while i >= 1 do
            local peg = pegs_by_type.explosive[i]

            if not peg_type_of[peg.handle] then
                table.remove(pegs_by_type.explosive, i)
            else
                local dx, dy, dz = bx - peg.x, by - peg.y, bz - peg.z
                local dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)

                if dist < PEG.explosive_trigger_radius then
                    DeactivatePeg(peg.handle)
                    table.remove(pegs_by_type.explosive, i)

                    -- Outward radial impulse
                    if dist > 0.01 then
                        local impulseScale = PEG.explosive_force / dist
                        MidwayPhysics.ApplyImpulse(ballHandle,
                            dx * impulseScale,
                            dy * impulseScale,
                            dz * impulseScale)
                    else
                        MidwayPhysics.ApplyImpulse(ballHandle, 0, PEG.explosive_force, 0)
                    end
                    break  -- one peg detonated per ball per frame
                end
            end
            i = i - 1
        end
    end
end

-- ── Score balls in slots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Check each slot sensor.  If triggered, find the ball in it and score it.
-- The ball is then returned to the pool.
local function CheckSlotScoring()
    for slotIdx, sensorHandle in pairs(slotSensors) do
        if MidwayPhysics.IsSensorTriggered(sensorHandle) then
            for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
                local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
                if bx and by then
                    if math.abs(by - SLOT.y) < SLOT.height then
                        local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers
                        local mult = slotMultipliers[slotIdx]
                        -- Luck modifier boosts payout
                        local luckBoost = math.max(0, 1.0 + MOD.luck * 0.5)
                        local score = math.floor(mult * luckBoost + 0.5)

                        slotScores[slotIdx] = slotScores[slotIdx] + score
                        totalTicketScore = totalTicketScore + score
                        ballsOnBoard = ballsOnBoard - 1

                        -- Award tickets through the engine economy bridge
                        local label = string.format("PLINKO  x%d", mult)
                        Engine.AwardTickets(score, label)

                        -- Return ball to pool
                        liveBalls[ballHandle] = nil
                        liveCount = liveCount - 1
                        MidwayPhysics.PoolReturn(ball_pool_name, ballHandle)
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ── Cull balls below the board ────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Any ball that falls below the gutter Y gets returned to the pool.
local function CullLostBalls()
    local culled = MidwayPhysics.PoolCullBelow(ball_pool_name, BALL.cull_y)
    for _, handle in ipairs(culled) do
        if liveBalls[handle] then
            ballsOnBoard = ballsOnBoard - 1
            liveBalls[handle] = nil
            liveCount = liveCount - 1
        end
    end
end

-- ── Ball drop timer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Heat modifier speeds up the drop rate and raises the cap.
local function TickBallSpawner(dt)
    local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers
    local heatMul = math.max(0.25, 1.0 + MOD.heat * 0.15)
    local interval = BALL.drop_interval_s / heatMul
    local maxOnBoard = math.max(1, BALL.max_concurrent + math.floor(MOD.heat * 3))

    ballTimer = ballTimer + dt
    if ballTimer >= interval and ballsOnBoard < maxOnBoard then
        ballTimer = 0
        SpawnBall()  -- SpawnBall increments ballsOnBoard internally
    end
end

-- ── Diagnostics ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function PrintDiagnostics()
    local totalScore = 0
    for i = 1, 7 do

        SLOT_ID, totalBallsDropped, ballsOnBoard,

        #pegs_by_type.fragile, #pegs_by_type.explosive,
        totalTicketScore))
end

        local isEven = (row % 2 == 0)
        local count = isEven and pegsPerEven or pegsPerOdd
        local zOff = zStart

            local restitution = PEG.restitution_normal
            local friction    = PEG.friction_normal
            if ptype == "bouncy" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_bouncy
                friction    = PEG.friction_bouncy
            elseif ptype == "sticky" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_sticky
                friction    = PEG.friction_sticky
            elseif ptype == "fragile" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_fragile
                friction    = PEG.friction_fragile
            elseif ptype == "explosive" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_explosive
                friction    = PEG.friction_explosive

            local handle = MidwayPhysics.SpawnStaticSphere(BOARD.board_x, y, pz, PEG.radius)
            if handle > 0 then
                MidwayPhysics.SetRestitution(handle, restitution)
                MidwayPhysics.SetFriction(handle, friction)

                local entry = { handle = handle, x = BOARD.board_x, y = y, z = pz, ptype = ptype }
                table.insert(pegs_by_type[ptype], entry)

-- 7 slots, centered, each SLOT.width wide.  Slots are sensor boxes.

-- 7 slots span Z, centred on Z=0. Sensors sit at (board_x, SLOT.y, sz).
local function BuildScoringSlots()
    local numSlots = 7
    local totalWidth = numSlots * SLOT.width
    local zStart = -totalWidth * 0.5 + SLOT.width * 0.5
    local multipliers = { 2, 5, 10, 50, 10, 5, 2 }

    for i = 1, numSlots do
        local sz = zStart + (i - 1) * SLOT.width

        local sensor = MidwayPhysics.SpawnSensorBox(BOARD.board_x, SLOT.y, sz,
            SLOT.depth * 2, SLOT.height, SLOT.width * 0.9)

        slotMultipliers[i] = multipliers[i]
        slotScores[i] = 0

local function CreateBallPool()

        radius   = BALL.radius,
        mass     = BALL.base_mass,
        friction = BALL.friction,
        restitution = BALL.restitution,

-- ── Spawn a ball at random X near the top ─────────────────────────────────────
-- Returns the handle, or 0 if pool exhausted.
-- Sleight of Hand modifier narrows the X drop spread.
local function SpawnBall()
    if MidwayPhysics.PoolFree(ball_pool_name) <= 0 then
        return 0
    end

    local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers
    -- Sleight of Hand narrows the Z drop spread
    local spread = BOARD.drop_spread * math.max(0.2, 1.0 - math.abs(MOD.sleight_of_hand) * 0.5)
    local bx = BOARD.board_x
    local by = BOARD.drop_y
    local bz = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread  -- vary along Z, not X

    local handle = MidwayPhysics.PoolAcquire(ball_pool_name, bx, by, bz)
    if handle > 0 then
        local mass = math.max(0.001, MOD.mass * BALL.base_mass)
        MidwayPhysics.SetMass(handle, mass)
        local ballFriction = math.max(0.0, MOD.friction * BALL.friction)
        MidwayPhysics.SetFriction(handle, ballFriction)

        liveBalls[handle] = true
        liveCount = liveCount + 1
        ballsOnBoard = ballsOnBoard + 1
        totalBallsDropped = totalBallsDropped + 1
    end
    return handle
end

-- ── Deactivate a peg (zero its collision properties) ─────────────────────────
-- Rather than calling DestroyBody (which would cause double-free when the C++
-- slot unloader tries to destroy the same bodies tracked in its dynamic list),
-- we simply zero out friction/restitution/gravity so the peg becomes inert.
local function DeactivatePeg(handle)
    if not handle or handle <= 0 then return end
    MidwayPhysics.SetFriction     (handle, 0.0)
    MidwayPhysics.SetRestitution  (handle, 0.0)
    MidwayPhysics.SetGravityFactor(handle, 0.0)
    peg_type_of[handle] = nil
end

-- ── Check fragile peg proximity ───────────────────────────────────────────────
-- If a ball is within fragile_trigger_radius of a fragile peg,
-- "shatter" it and give the ball a small velocity boost.
local function CheckFragilePegs()
    if #pegs_by_type.fragile == 0 then return end

    for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
        local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
        if not bx then break end

        local i = #pegs_by_type.fragile
        while i >= 1 do
            local peg = pegs_by_type.fragile[i]

            -- Skip already-deactivated pegs (clean up the list)
            if not peg_type_of[peg.handle] then
                table.remove(pegs_by_type.fragile, i)
            else
                local dx, dy, dz = bx - peg.x, by - peg.y, bz - peg.z
                local dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)

                if dist < PEG.fragile_trigger_radius then
                    DeactivatePeg(peg.handle)
                    table.remove(pegs_by_type.fragile, i)

                    -- Velocity kick to the ball
                    local vx, vy, vz = MidwayPhysics.GetVelocity(ballHandle)
                    if vx then
                        vx = vx + (math.random() - 0.5) * PEG.fragile_kick
                        vy = vy + PEG.fragile_kick * 0.5
                        vz = vz + (math.random() - 0.5) * PEG.fragile_kick
                        MidwayPhysics.SetLinearVelocity(ballHandle, vx, vy, vz)
                    end
                    break  -- one peg shattered per ball per frame
                end
            end
            i = i - 1
        end
    end
end

-- ── Check explosive peg proximity ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- If a ball is within explosive_trigger_radius of an explosive peg,
-- apply outward radial impulse and deactivate the peg.
local function CheckExplosivePegs()
    if #pegs_by_type.explosive == 0 then return end

    for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
        local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
        if not bx then break end

        local i = #pegs_by_type.explosive
        while i >= 1 do
            local peg = pegs_by_type.explosive[i]

            if not peg_type_of[peg.handle] then
                table.remove(pegs_by_type.explosive, i)
            else
                local dx, dy, dz = bx - peg.x, by - peg.y, bz - peg.z
                local dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)

                if dist < PEG.explosive_trigger_radius then
                    DeactivatePeg(peg.handle)
                    table.remove(pegs_by_type.explosive, i)

                    -- Outward radial impulse
                    if dist > 0.01 then
                        local impulseScale = PEG.explosive_force / dist
                        MidwayPhysics.ApplyImpulse(ballHandle,
                            dx * impulseScale,
                            dy * impulseScale,
                            dz * impulseScale)
                    else
                        MidwayPhysics.ApplyImpulse(ballHandle, 0, PEG.explosive_force, 0)
                    end
                    break  -- one peg detonated per ball per frame
                end
            end
            i = i - 1
        end
    end
end

-- ── Score balls in slots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Check each slot sensor.  If triggered, find the ball in it and score it.
-- The ball is then returned to the pool.
local function CheckSlotScoring()
    for slotIdx, sensorHandle in pairs(slotSensors) do
        if MidwayPhysics.IsSensorTriggered(sensorHandle) then
            for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
                local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
                if bx and by then
                    if math.abs(by - SLOT.y) < SLOT.height then
                        local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers
                        local mult = slotMultipliers[slotIdx]
                        -- Luck modifier boosts payout
                        local luckBoost = math.max(0, 1.0 + MOD.luck * 0.5)
                        local score = math.floor(mult * luckBoost + 0.5)

                        slotScores[slotIdx] = slotScores[slotIdx] + score
                        totalTicketScore = totalTicketScore + score
                        ballsOnBoard = ballsOnBoard - 1

                        -- Award tickets through the engine economy bridge
                        local label = string.format("PLINKO  x%d", mult)
                        Engine.AwardTickets(score, label)

                        -- Return ball to pool
                        liveBalls[ballHandle] = nil
                        liveCount = liveCount - 1
                        MidwayPhysics.PoolReturn(ball_pool_name, ballHandle)
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ── Cull balls below the board ────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Any ball that falls below the gutter Y gets returned to the pool.
local function CullLostBalls()
    local culled = MidwayPhysics.PoolCullBelow(ball_pool_name, BALL.cull_y)
    for _, handle in ipairs(culled) do
        if liveBalls[handle] then
            ballsOnBoard = ballsOnBoard - 1
            liveBalls[handle] = nil
            liveCount = liveCount - 1
        end
    end
end

-- ── Ball drop timer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Heat modifier speeds up the drop rate and raises the cap.
local function TickBallSpawner(dt)
    local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers
    local heatMul = math.max(0.25, 1.0 + MOD.heat * 0.15)
    local interval = BALL.drop_interval_s / heatMul
    local maxOnBoard = math.max(1, BALL.max_concurrent + math.floor(MOD.heat * 3))

    ballTimer = ballTimer + dt
    if ballTimer >= interval and ballsOnBoard < maxOnBoard then
        ballTimer = 0
        SpawnBall()  -- SpawnBall increments ballsOnBoard internally
    end
end

    local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers or {}
    -- Sleight of Hand narrows the Z drop spread
    local spread = BOARD.drop_spread * math.max(0.2, 1.0 - math.abs(MOD.sleight_of_hand) * 0.5)

        local ballFriction = math.max(0.0, MOD.friction * BALL.friction)

-- Triangular (diamond) pattern:
--   Row 0 (Y=top):  7 pegs  (even rows)
--   Row 1:          6 pegs  (odd rows, offset half spacing)
--   Row 2:          7 pegs
--   ...
-- Bottom row feeds into 7 scoring slots (one below each gap between bottom pegs).
--
-- Even rows: pegs at x = offset + i * spacing,  i=0..pegsPerRow-1
-- Odd rows:  pegs at x = offset + spacing/2 + i * spacing

-- Board is now in the ZY plane (wide axis = Z, tall axis = Y).
-- board_x is the fixed X position of all pegs/sensors (face-on to the player).
local function BuildPegField()
    local pegsPerEven = 7
    local pegsPerOdd  = 6
    local yStart = BOARD.peg_top_y
    local yEnd   = BOARD.peg_bot_y
    local numRows = 8
    local rowSpacing = (yStart - yEnd) / (numRows - 1)
    local zStart = -(pegsPerEven - 1) * PEG.h_spacing * 0.5  -- centred on Z=0

    local totalPegs = 0

    for row = 0, numRows - 1 do
        local y = yStart - row * rowSpacing
        local isEven = (row % 2 == 0)
        local count = isEven and pegsPerEven or pegsPerOdd
        local zOff = zStart
        if not isEven then
            zOff = zStart + PEG.h_spacing * 0.5
        end

        for i = 0, count - 1 do
            local pz = zOff + i * PEG.h_spacing
            local ptype = PickPegType()

            local restitution = PEG.restitution_normal
            local friction    = PEG.friction_normal
            if ptype == "bouncy" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_bouncy
                friction    = PEG.friction_bouncy

                restitution = PEG.restitution_sticky
                friction    = PEG.friction_sticky
            elseif ptype == "fragile" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_fragile
                friction    = PEG.friction_fragile
            elseif ptype == "explosive" then
                restitution = PEG.restitution_explosive
                friction    = PEG.friction_explosive

            -- Pegs placed at (board_x, y, pz) — board face is in the ZY plane
            local handle = MidwayPhysics.SpawnStaticSphere(BOARD.board_x, y, pz, PEG.radius)
            if handle > 0 then
                MidwayPhysics.SetRestitution(handle, restitution)
                MidwayPhysics.SetFriction(handle, friction)

                local entry = { handle = handle, x = BOARD.board_x, y = y, z = pz, ptype = ptype }
                table.insert(pegs_by_type[ptype], entry)
                peg_type_of[handle] = ptype
                totalPegs = totalPegs + 1
            end
        end
    end

    print(string.format("[plinko] slot#%d  Peg field: %d pegs (n=%d b=%d s=%d f=%d e=%d)",
        SLOT_ID, totalPegs,
        #pegs_by_type.normal, #pegs_by_type.bouncy,
        #pegs_by_type.sticky, #pegs_by_type.fragile,
        #pegs_by_type.explosive))

local function BuildScoringSlots()
    local numSlots = 7
    local totalWidth = numSlots * SLOT.width
    local zStart = -totalWidth * 0.5 + SLOT.width * 0.5
    local multipliers = { 2, 5, 10, 50, 10, 5, 2 }

    for i = 1, numSlots do

        local sensor = MidwayPhysics.SpawnSensorBox(BOARD.board_x, SLOT.y, sz,
            SLOT.depth * 2, SLOT.height, SLOT.width * 0.9)

-- Returns the handle, or 0 if pool exhausted.
-- Sleight of Hand modifier narrows the X drop spread.
local function SpawnBall()
    if MidwayPhysics.PoolFree(ball_pool_name) <= 0 then
        return 0
    end

    local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers
    -- Sleight of Hand narrows the Z drop spread
    local spread = BOARD.drop_spread * math.max(0.2, 1.0 - math.abs(MOD.sleight_of_hand) * 0.5)
    local bx = BOARD.board_x
    local by = BOARD.drop_y
    local bz = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread  -- vary along Z, not X

    local handle = MidwayPhysics.PoolAcquire(ball_pool_name, bx, by, bz)
    if handle > 0 then
        local mass = math.max(0.001, MOD.mass * BALL.base_mass)
        MidwayPhysics.SetMass(handle, mass)
        local ballFriction = math.max(0.0, MOD.friction * BALL.friction)
        MidwayPhysics.SetFriction(handle, ballFriction)

        liveBalls[handle] = true
        liveCount = liveCount + 1
        ballsOnBoard = ballsOnBoard + 1
        totalBallsDropped = totalBallsDropped + 1
    end
    return handle
end

-- ── Deactivate a peg (zero its collision properties) ─────────────────────────
-- Rather than calling DestroyBody (which would cause double-free when the C++
-- slot unloader tries to destroy the same bodies tracked in its dynamic list),
-- we simply zero out friction/restitution/gravity so the peg becomes inert.
local function DeactivatePeg(handle)
    if not handle or handle <= 0 then return end
    MidwayPhysics.SetFriction     (handle, 0.0)
    MidwayPhysics.SetRestitution  (handle, 0.0)
    MidwayPhysics.SetGravityFactor(handle, 0.0)
    peg_type_of[handle] = nil
end

-- ── Check fragile peg proximity ───────────────────────────────────────────────
-- If a ball is within fragile_trigger_radius of a fragile peg,
-- "shatter" it and give the ball a small velocity boost.
local function CheckFragilePegs()
    if #pegs_by_type.fragile == 0 then return end

    for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
        local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
        if not bx then break end

        local i = #pegs_by_type.fragile
        while i >= 1 do
            local peg = pegs_by_type.fragile[i]

            -- Skip already-deactivated pegs (clean up the list)
            if not peg_type_of[peg.handle] then
                table.remove(pegs_by_type.fragile, i)
            else
                local dx, dy, dz = bx - peg.x, by - peg.y, bz - peg.z
                local dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)

                if dist < PEG.fragile_trigger_radius then
                    DeactivatePeg(peg.handle)
                    table.remove(pegs_by_type.fragile, i)

                    -- Velocity kick to the ball
                    local vx, vy, vz = MidwayPhysics.GetVelocity(ballHandle)
                    if vx then
                        vx = vx + (math.random() - 0.5) * PEG.fragile_kick
                        vy = vy + PEG.fragile_kick * 0.5
                        vz = vz + (math.random() - 0.5) * PEG.fragile_kick
                        MidwayPhysics.SetLinearVelocity(ballHandle, vx, vy, vz)
                    end
                    break  -- one peg shattered per ball per frame
                end
            end
            i = i - 1
        end
    end

-- ── Check explosive peg proximity ─────────────────────────────────────────────
-- If a ball is within explosive_trigger_radius of an explosive peg,
-- apply outward radial impulse and deactivate the peg.
local function CheckExplosivePegs()
    if #pegs_by_type.explosive == 0 then return end

    for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
        local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
        if not bx then break end

        local i = #pegs_by_type.explosive
        while i >= 1 do
            local peg = pegs_by_type.explosive[i]

            if not peg_type_of[peg.handle] then
                table.remove(pegs_by_type.explosive, i)
            else
                local dx, dy, dz = bx - peg.x, by - peg.y, bz - peg.z
                local dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)

                if dist < PEG.explosive_trigger_radius then
                    DeactivatePeg(peg.handle)
                    table.remove(pegs_by_type.explosive, i)

                    -- Outward radial impulse
                    if dist > 0.01 then
                        local impulseScale = PEG.explosive_force / dist
                        MidwayPhysics.ApplyImpulse(ballHandle,
                            dx * impulseScale,
                            dy * impulseScale,
                            dz * impulseScale)
                    else
                        MidwayPhysics.ApplyImpulse(ballHandle, 0, PEG.explosive_force, 0)
                    end
                    break  -- one peg detonated per ball per frame
                end
            end
            i = i - 1
        end
    end
end

-- Check each slot sensor.  If triggered, find the ball in it and score it.
-- The ball is then returned to the pool.
local function CheckSlotScoring()
    for slotIdx, sensorHandle in pairs(slotSensors) do
        if MidwayPhysics.IsSensorTriggered(sensorHandle) then
            for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
                local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
                if bx and by then
                    if math.abs(by - SLOT.y) < SLOT.height then
                        local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers
                        local mult = slotMultipliers[slotIdx]
                        -- Luck modifier boosts payout
                        local luckBoost = math.max(0, 1.0 + MOD.luck * 0.5)
                        local score = math.floor(mult * luckBoost + 0.5)

                        slotScores[slotIdx] = slotScores[slotIdx] + score
                        totalTicketScore = totalTicketScore + score
                        ballsOnBoard = ballsOnBoard - 1

                        -- Award tickets through the engine economy bridge
                        local label = string.format("PLINKO  x%d", mult)
                        Engine.AwardTickets(score, label)

                        -- Return ball to pool
                        liveBalls[ballHandle] = nil
                        liveCount = liveCount - 1
                        MidwayPhysics.PoolReturn(ball_pool_name, ballHandle)
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ── Cull balls below the board ────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Any ball that falls below the gutter Y gets returned to the pool.
local function CullLostBalls()
    local culled = MidwayPhysics.PoolCullBelow(ball_pool_name, BALL.cull_y)
    for _, handle in ipairs(culled) do
        if liveBalls[handle] then
            ballsOnBoard = ballsOnBoard - 1
            liveBalls[handle] = nil
            liveCount = liveCount - 1
        end
    end
end

-- Heat modifier speeds up the drop rate and raises the cap.
local function TickBallSpawner(dt)
    local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers
    local heatMul = math.max(0.25, 1.0 + MOD.heat * 0.15)
    local interval = BALL.drop_interval_s / heatMul
    local maxOnBoard = math.max(1, BALL.max_concurrent + math.floor(MOD.heat * 3))

    ballTimer = ballTimer + dt
    if ballTimer >= interval and ballsOnBoard < maxOnBoard then
        ballTimer = 0
        SpawnBall()  -- SpawnBall increments ballsOnBoard internally
    end
end

                friction    = PEG.friction_fragile

                friction    = PEG.friction_explosive

            local handle = MidwayPhysics.SpawnStaticSphere(BOARD.board_x, y, pz, PEG.radius)

    if MidwayPhysics.PoolFree(ball_pool_name) <= 0 then
        return 0
    end

    local MOD = AttractionConstants.modifiers or {}
    -- Sleight of Hand narrows the Z drop spread
    local spread = BOARD.drop_spread * math.max(0.2, 1.0 - math.abs(MOD.sleight_of_hand) * 0.5)
    local bx = BOARD.board_x
    local by = BOARD.drop_y
    local bz = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread  -- vary along Z, not X

    local handle = MidwayPhysics.PoolAcquire(ball_pool_name, bx, by, bz)
    if handle > 0 then
        local mass = math.max(0.001, MOD.mass * BALL.base_mass)
        MidwayPhysics.SetMass(handle, mass)
        local ballFriction = math.max(0.0, MOD.friction * BALL.friction)
        MidwayPhysics.SetFriction(handle, ballFriction)

        liveBalls[handle] = true
        liveCount = liveCount + 1
        ballsOnBoard = ballsOnBoard + 1

    return handle

    if not handle or handle <= 0 then return end
    MidwayPhysics.SetFriction     (handle, 0.0)
    MidwayPhysics.SetRestitution  (handle, 0.0)

    for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
        local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
        if not bx then break end

        local i = #pegs_by_type.fragile
        while i >= 1 do
            local peg = pegs_by_type.fragile[i]

            -- Skip already-deactivated pegs (clean up the list)
            if not peg_type_of[peg.handle] then
                table.remove(pegs_by_type.fragile, i)
            else
                local dx, dy, dz = bx - peg.x, by - peg.y, bz - peg.z
                local dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)

                if dist < PEG.fragile_trigger_radius then
                    DeactivatePeg(peg.handle)
                    table.remove(pegs_by_type.fragile, i)

                    -- Velocity kick to the ball
                    local vx, vy, vz = MidwayPhysics.GetVelocity(ballHandle)
                    if vx then
                        vx = vx + (math.random() - 0.5) * PEG.fragile_kick
                        vy = vy + PEG.fragile_kick * 0.5
                        vz = vz + (math.random() - 0.5) * PEG.fragile_kick
                        MidwayPhysics.SetLinearVelocity(ballHandle, vx, vy, vz)

                    break  -- one peg shattered per ball per frame

            end
            i = i - 1
        end

local function CheckExplosivePegs()
    if #pegs_by_type.explosive == 0 then return end

    for ballHandle, _ in pairs(liveBalls) do
        local bx, by, bz = MidwayPhysics.GetPosition(ballHandle)
        if not bx then break end

        local i = #pegs_by_type.explosive
        while i >= 1 do
            local peg = pegs_by_type.explosive[i]

            if not peg_type_of[peg.handle] then
                table.remove(pegs_by_type.explosive, i)
            else
                local dx, dy, dz = bx - peg.x, by - peg.y, bz - peg.z
                local dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)

                if dist < PEG.explosive_trigger_radius then
                    DeactivatePeg(peg.handle)
                    table.remove(pegs_by_type.explosive, i)

                    -- Outward radial impulse
                    if dist > 0.01 then
                        local impulseScale = PEG.explosive_force / dist
                        MidwayPhysics.ApplyImpulse(ballHandle,
                            dx * impulseScale,
                            dy * impulseScale,
                            dz * impulseScale)
                    else
                        MidwayPhysics.ApplyImpulse(ballHandle, 0, PEG.explosive_force, 0)
                    end
                    break  -- one peg detonated per ball per frame
                end
            end
            i = i - 1
        end
    end
end

                        liveCount = liveCount - 1

                end
            end
        end
    end

            else
                local dx, dy, dz = bx - peg.x, by - peg.y, bz - peg.z
                local dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)

                    table.remove(pegs_by_type.fragile, i)

                        vy = vy + PEG.fragile_kick * 0.5
                        vz = vz + (math.random() - 0.5) * PEG.fragile_kick
                        MidwayPhysics.SetLinearVelocity(ballHandle, vx, vy, vz)

--   Row 2:          7 pegs

    local pegsPerOdd  = 6

        local zOff = zStart

            zOff = zStart + PEG.h_spacing * 0.5

            local friction    = PEG.friction_normal

                friction    = PEG.friction_bouncy

                friction    = PEG.friction_sticky
            elseif ptype == "fragile" then

                friction    = PEG.friction_fragile
            elseif ptype == "explosive" then

                friction    = PEG.friction_explosive

                totalPegs = totalPegs + 1
